next.reason: 1985: 'all LABEL RECORDS clauses in the run unit which are associated with this file connector must have the same specification'; 2023: '13.4.5.4 GR2 lists BLOCK CONTAINS, CODE-SET, LINAGE, record size, REPORT for external files; no LABEL RECORDS clause exists'. No 2023 clause holds LABEL RECORDS. The external-file consistency rules in 13.4.5.4 GR2 omit it, so the clause and this requirement are dropped.
